# a2av.cu figure, in the house style of dgx-spark/latency/plot/plotstyle.py.
import matplotlib as mpl
from matplotlib.ticker import FixedLocator, FormatStrFormatter, NullFormatter, NullLocator
HOUSE = {
    "font.size": 16, "axes.titlesize": 17, "axes.labelsize": 16,
    "xtick.labelsize": 13, "ytick.labelsize": 13, "legend.fontsize": 13,
    "legend.title_fontsize": 13, "figure.titlesize": 18,
    "axes.spines.right": False, "axes.spines.top": False,
    "axes.grid": True, "grid.alpha": 0.3, "lines.linewidth": 2.2, "lines.markersize": 6,
}
# DSMEM methods in blues/purple, global-memory methods in oranges/red.
METHODS = {
    "dsmem-push": ("#1f77b4", "o"), "dsmem-pull": ("#17becf", "o"), "dsmem-bulk": ("#9467bd", "o"),
    "gmem-ldst": ("#ff7f0e", "s"), "gmem-tma": ("#d62728", "s"),
}
DISTRIBUTIONS = ["UNIMODALFLAT", "UNIMODALPEAK", "MONOTONEDECAY", "HEAVYTAIL"]


def start(fig, size):
    """Throw away the default rendering and start a clean figure in the house style."""
    mpl.rcdefaults()
    mpl.rcParams.update(HOUSE)
    fig.clear()
    fig.set_layout_engine("constrained")
    fig.set_size_inches(*size)


def message_size_axis(ax, sizes):
    """log2 x axis labelled with the message sizes that were run."""
    ax.set_xscale("log", base=2)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator(sizes))
    ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(NullLocator())
    ax.set_xticklabels([f"{s}" if s < 1024 else f"{s // 1024} Ki" for s in sizes])


def panels(fig, distributions, rows, cols):
    """One axes per distribution present in the data, sharing both axes."""
    axes = fig.subplots(rows, cols, sharex=True, sharey=True, squeeze=False).ravel()
    for ax in axes[len(distributions):]:
        ax.set_visible(False)
    return list(zip(axes, distributions))


def one_legend(fig, axes):
    """A single legend above the panels instead of one per panel."""
    handles, labels = {}, {}
    for ax in axes:
        for h, l in zip(*ax.get_legend_handles_labels()):
            handles.setdefault(l, h)
    fig.legend(handles.values(), handles.keys(), loc="outside upper center",
               ncol=len(handles), frameon=False)

def customize_matplotlib(fig, ax, config):
    start(fig, (14, 9.5))
    present = [d for d in DISTRIBUTIONS if d in set(df["distribution"])]
    sizes = sorted(df["avg_msgsize"].unique())
    used = []
    for ax, dist in panels(fig, present, 2, 2):
        part = df[df["distribution"] == dist]
        for method, (color, marker) in METHODS.items():
            line = part[part["method"] == method].sort_values("avg_msgsize")
            ax.plot(line["avg_msgsize"], line["ns_per_exchange"] / 1000, color=color,
                    marker=marker, label=method)
        # The two cluster.sync() of every exchange, with no data: the floor.
        floor = part[part["method"] == "cluster-sync"].sort_values("avg_msgsize")
        ax.plot(floor["avg_msgsize"], floor["ns_per_exchange"] / 1000, color="0.5",
                linestyle="--", linewidth=1.6, label="barriers only")
        ax.set_title(dist)
        ax.set_yscale("log")
        # plain numbers instead of 10^0, 10^1 on the log axis
        ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator([0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20]))
        ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FormatStrFormatter("%g"))
        ax.yaxis.set_minor_formatter(NullFormatter())
        message_size_axis(ax, sizes)
        used.append(ax)
    fig.supxlabel("average message size (bytes)")
    fig.supylabel("time per exchange (µs)")
    one_legend(fig, used)

single.sql:
SELECT distribution, method, avg_msgsize, ns_per_exchange AS slowdown
FROM a2av
WHERE method != 'cluster-sync'
single.transformScript:
# How much slower each method gets when the pattern is unbalanced: the
# median time with a distribution / the median time with UNIMODALFLAT
# (the balanced one), at the same average message size.
df = df.groupby(['distribution', 'method', 'avg_msgsize'], as_index=False)['slowdown'].median()
balanced = df[df['distribution'] == 'UNIMODALFLAT'].set_index(['method', 'avg_msgsize'])['slowdown']
df = df[df['distribution'] != 'UNIMODALFLAT'].copy()
df['slowdown'] = df['slowdown'].values / balanced.reindex(
    list(zip(df['method'], df['avg_msgsize']))).values

single.sql:
SELECT distribution, method, avg_msgsize, busy_max_ns AS busy_ratio, busy_mean_ns
FROM a2av
WHERE method != 'cluster-sync'
single.transformScript:
# Per repetition: time the busiest block spent moving bytes / the mean
# over the blocks (1 = perfectly balanced work); then the median.
df['busy_ratio'] = df['busy_ratio'] / df['busy_mean_ns']
df = df.groupby(['distribution', 'method', 'avg_msgsize'], as_index=False)['busy_ratio'].median()

def customize_matplotlib(fig, ax, config):
    start(fig, (9, 5.6))
    ax = fig.add_subplot()
    d = df.sort_values("stride_bytes")
    strides = d["stride_bytes"].tolist()
    # Threads s/4 words apart: a warp's 32 accesses fall in 32 / (s/4) banks,
    # so each bank serves min(32, s/4) of them one after the other.
    ways = [min(32, s // 4) for s in strides]
    # 4-byte loads also cannot go beyond 64 B/cycle (the instruction rate).
    expected = [min(64, 128 / w) for w in ways]
    # a wide band, so it stays visible under a measurement that matches it
    ax.plot(strides, expected, color="0.6", linewidth=9, alpha=0.4, solid_capstyle="round",
            label="expected: 128 B/cycle / ways, at most 64")
    ax.plot(strides, d["bytes_per_cycle_per_sm"], color="#1f77b4", marker="o",
            label="measured")
    ax.set_xscale("log", base=2)
    ax.set_yscale("log", base=2)
    ax.xaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator(strides))
    ax.xaxis.set_minor_locator(NullLocator())
    ax.set_xticklabels([f"{s}\n{w}-way" for s, w in zip(strides, ways)])
    ax.yaxis.set_major_locator(FixedLocator([4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128]))
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(FormatStrFormatter("%g"))
    ax.yaxis.set_minor_formatter(NullFormatter())
    ax.set_xlabel("bytes between consecutive threads (bank conflict)")
    ax.set_ylabel("bytes / cycle, one SM")
    ax.set_title("4-byte reads")
    ax.legend(frameon=False)
